string.name: Title
string.value: Min Crit

string.name: Desc
string.value: The minimum damage bonus for Critical attacks. You can enhance this value by using skills or items. This value does not affect normal damage.

string.name: Title
string.value: Max Crit

string.name: Desc
string.value: The maximum damage bonus for Critical attacks. You can enhance this value by using skills or items. This value does not affect normal damage.

string.name: Title
string.value: Boss ATT

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Boss ATT, the greater your damage on Boss monsters. This value does not affect normal damage. It is determined by the total Boss ATT of your skills and equipment items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Ignore Defense

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Defense Ignore value, the less enemy defenses will reduce your attack damage. It is determined by the total Defense Ignore amount of your skills and equipment items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Status Resistance

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your chance of resisting abnormal status effects. The higher it is, the lower your chance of being affected by harmful effects. You can enhance this value by using skills or items. \r\nUp to 100%

string.name: Title
string.value: Power Stance

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your chance of being pushed back by monster attacks. You can enhance this value by using skills. \r\nUp to 100%

string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Defense

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Weapon Defense, the less weapon damage you will receive from enemies. It is determined by adding your stat to the Weapon DEF of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Defense

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Magic Defense, the less magic damage you will receive from enemies. It is determined by adding your Magic Defense stat to that of all equipped armor items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Accuracy

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines the accuracy of your Weapon Attack. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at landing eapon attacks. Determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Accuracy

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines the accuracy of your Magic Attack. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at landingmagic attacks. Determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Avoidability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines your chance of avoiding weapon attacks. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at avoiding weapon attacks. Determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Avoidability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines your chance of avoiding magic attacks. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at avoiding magic attacks. Determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your movement speed cannot be increased beyond 140%. Skills and equipment can be used to increase or decrease your speed. Speed can be increased to 190% while riding a mount.

string.name: Desc
string.value: How high you can jump. It cannot be increased beyond 123%. Skills and equipment can be used to increase or decrease your Jump.

string.name: Title
string.value: Honor Level

string.name: Desc
string.value: Accumulate Honor EXP to increase your character's Honor Level. You will receive a Circulator with each level-up, up to Lv. 31, when you will gain Circulators for earning set amounts of Honor EXP.

string.name: Title
string.value: Honor EXP

string.name: Desc
string.value: Once you reach 100% Honor EXP, you will gain a new Honor Level. Honor EXP can be acquired from Medals of Honor in the Fight for Azwan.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your latent abilities. The powers are opened in order when reaching Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70, and can be reset with a Circulator.

string.name: Title
string.value: Waiting Zero

string.name: Desc
string.value: Zero's HP and TF during the Tag standby mode.

string.name: Title
string.value: Health Point

string.name: Desc
string.value: Zero's HP during the Tag standby mode. 16% Max HP is restored every 4 seconds.

string.name: Title
string.value: Time Force

string.name: Desc
string.value: Zero's Time Force (TF) during the Tag standby mode. 20 TF is restored every second.
